description:
Automate your patch management

Update third-party software, deploy custom scripts, and make impactful configuration changes to your on-prem Windows devices in minutes with PDQ Deploy.
New Features
- Added ExportSettings CLI command to export all preferences for automated backup and configuration management workflows
- Added BackupDatabase CLI command to create on-demand database backups with support for custom paths and automated workflows
- Added AI coding agent skill file documenting all CLI commands for use with Claude Code, OpenCode, and other AI-assisted tools and agentic workflows
- Added CLI commands to export and import custom variables.
- Added new dashboard widgets powered by custom SQL reports (SQL Metric, Bar Graph, Pie Graph, Multi Metric), a Collection Metric widget, a Changelog widget, clickable cards, and an improved widget library with previews, descriptions, and configuration
- Deploy: Added ARM64 processor support for package and step O/S architecture conditions
- Deploy: Added CLI command to approve auto-downloaded packages for integration with change management and automated approval workflows
- Inventory: Added support for scanning ARM64 processor targets, including a new processor Architecture field (for example 64-bit (ARM64)) available on the CPU page, in reports, and in collections
- Inventory: Added ability to automatically assign scan credentials via CLI parameter when using AddComputers

Improvements
- Deploy: Added -PrioritizeDeployment parameter to Deploy CLI command for urgent deployment scenarios
- Deploy: Include Schedule ID in the Audit Log Target Identifier for Deployment Schedules

Bug Fixes
- Deploy: Fixed `-OverrideTargetFilters` CLI flag so it correctly bypasses the target exclusion list when starting a deployment
- Deploy: Fixed Auto Download approvals not appearing until the Package Library window was manually refreshed
- Deploy: Fixed an issue where Auto Download packages would stop receiving updates if the downloaded version was pulled or pruned from the Package Library
- Inventory: Fixed Windows Feature scanner taking several minutes to complete and failing on Windows 11 Enterprise Multi-Session devices, and added a Server Features list (with install state) to the Windows Features page on Windows Server
